title: Sunday · the Rain, 2012
logline: Fifteenth January, and the first Rain Sunday with the Era III line: the alley wet-on-wet, the garage window dark at three in the morning because he's at the motel desk, and the last tier the motel from the lot with a hum line under it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the alley behind the tavern in January rain, wet-on-wet, the beer sign's neon bleeding into the puddle.

image.prompt: a gravel alley behind a tavern in January rain painted wet-on-wet with a beer sign's neon bleeding into a puddle, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Alley

panels.composition: Tier 2: the casement window dark, three jars on the sill, no lamp, 3 AM.

panels.name: Dark

panels.composition: Tier 3: the motel from its lot at 3 AM, the office lit, a shape at the desk, a thin line under the tier.

panels.name: Motel

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Fifteenth Rain. The window dark; the hum line under the motel.
